```{=html}
<div class="dash">
  <div class="dash-side">
    <h2>Explore the ladder</h2>
    <label>Study area<select id="dash-site"></select></label>
    <label>Quick comparison<select id="dash-preset"></select></label>
    <fieldset class="dash-mode">
      <label><input type="radio" name="dash-mode" value="one" checked> One measure</label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="dash-mode" value="compare"> Compare A and B</label>
    </fieldset>
    <label>Measure A<select id="dash-a"></select></label>
    <label id="dash-b-row" style="display:none">Measure B<select id="dash-b"></select></label>
    <label id="dash-radius-row">Radius (m)<select id="dash-radius"></select></label>
    <label class="inline"><input type="checkbox" id="dash-base" checked> Basemap</label>
    <h3>Zoom to</h3>
    <div id="dash-windows"></div>
    <p class="muted small">Values are percentile ranks within the study area (interior streets).
      Compare mode maps A minus B: red where A ranks a street higher, blue where B does, grey
      within 10 points. Street data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).</p>
  </div>
  <div class="dash-main">
    <div id="dash-head"></div>
    <div class="dash-mapwrap">
      <div id="dash-map"></div>
      <div id="dash-legend"></div>
      <div id="dash-tip"></div>
      <div id="dash-status"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="dash-right">
    <section>
      <h3>A against B</h3>
      <canvas id="dash-scatter" width="340" height="260"></canvas>
      <div id="dash-rho" class="small"></div>
    </section>
    <section>
      <h3>Agreement along the ladder</h3>
      <div id="dash-agree"></div>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>
```
